source: historical Steer campaign main1000_w050; not R05 generated data

support.matching: Distinct immediate parents, common grandparent, nearest online score, no pair reuse; equal families and batches

observations.matched_effects: Across inspected matched spatial/geometry features, the smallest multiplicity-corrected q is approximately 0.9753; no corrected-significant feature or fixed motif is supported. Do not elevate the smallest uncorrected contrast into a motif claim.
observations.trend_coverage: Trends are explicitly sparse observed matched-family trends with missing events not imputed; supported time points are not a complete event series.
observations.censoring: The evidence reports mean censored fraction 0.9042577030812327. Extinct branches have unknown future outcomes, so matched observations are survivor-conditioned and do not establish effects over all branches.
observations.interpretation_limits: Contact and occupancy values are spatial geometry proxies, not interaction energies or proof of binding. Coordinate trend derivatives are descriptive fits, not spatial forces or calibrated native rates. Related descendants and repeated event times are not independent samples.
observations.scope: Descriptive diagnostic only. R05 prospective evaluation remains pending; this analysis selects no next-round design or parameters.
